translationRepairs: Her father Shi Yue, in the closing years of Sui, held the rank of captain in the Eagle-Forging Garrison.
Her father Shiyue, in the closing years of Sui, held the rank of captain in the Eagle-Soaring (Yingyang) Garrison.
士彠 is one given name (Shiyue), not surname Shi + Yue; 鷹揚 means 'eagle-soaring', not 'forging'.
Her father Shi Yue, at the end of the Sui dynasty's Daye reign, served as captain of the Eagle-Forging Garrison.
Her father Shiyue, at the end of the Sui dynasty's Daye reign, served as captain of the Eagle-Soaring (Yingyang) Garrison.
士彠 is one given name (Shiyue); 鷹揚 means 'eagle-soaring'.
On gengwu the heir's grandson Chongzhao was stripped to common rank.
On gengwu the Imperial Grandson-Heir Chongzhao was stripped to common rank.
皇太孫 is the title of the emperor's grandson designated heir, not 'the heir's grandson'.
On gengwu the heir's grandson Chongzhao was deposed to commoner status.
On gengwu the Imperial Grandson-Heir Chongzhao was deposed to commoner status.
皇太孫 is the title of the emperor's grandson designated heir, not 'the heir's grandson'.
In the third month the deposed heir Xian died in Bazhou.
In the third month the commoner Xian died in Bazhou.
The source says only 庶人賢 'the commoner Xian'; 'deposed heir' is not in the packet.
Prince Shangjin of Bi was made Prince of Ze; Prince Sunjie of Ge was made Prince of Xu.
Prince Shangjin of Bi was made Prince of Ze; Prince Sujie of Ge was made Prince of Xu.
素節 is read Sujie (素 sù).
Prince Shangjin of Bi was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Ze; Prince Sunjie of Ge as Prince of Xu.
Prince Shangjin of Bi was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Ze; Prince Sujie of Ge as Prince of Xu.
素節 is read Sujie (素 sù).
Luoyang was renamed the Divine Capital, and the Secretariat together with many ministry titles were retitled.
Luoyang was renamed the Divine Capital, and the Department of State Affairs together with many ministry titles were retitled.
尚書省 is the Department of State Affairs; the Secretariat is 中書省.
The Eastern Capital was renamed the Divine Capital, and the Secretariat and the names of the various offices were also changed.
The Eastern Capital was renamed the Divine Capital, and the Department of State Affairs and the names of the various offices were also changed.
尚書省 is the Department of State Affairs; the Secretariat is 中書省.

Xu Jingye, grandson of Li Ji and marshal of Liuzhou, posed as acting prefect of Yangzhou, murdered chief administrator Chen Jingzhi, seized the city, declared himself supreme commander, and marched under the banner of restoring Tang.

Xu Jingye, grandson of Li Ji and marshal of Liuzhou, posed as marshal of Yangzhou, murdered chief administrator Chen Jingzhi, seized the city, declared himself supreme commander, and marched under the banner of restoring Tang.
偽稱揚州司馬: he falsely claimed to be marshal (sima) of Yangzhou, not acting prefect.

Xu Jingye, grandson of the former Minister of Works Li Ji and prefectural marshal of Liuzhou, falsely styled himself acting prefect of Yangzhou, killed the chief administrator Chen Jingzhi, seized Yangzhou and raised troops, styled himself supreme commander, and took restoration of the dynasty as his pretext.

Xu Jingye, grandson of the former Minister of Works Li Ji and prefectural marshal of Liuzhou, falsely styled himself marshal of Yangzhou, killed the chief administrator Chen Jingzhi, seized Yangzhou and raised troops, styled himself supreme commander, and took restoration of the dynasty as his pretext.
偽稱揚州司馬: 司馬 is marshal (sima), not acting prefect.
Liu Ren'gui, the great commander, died.
The source says only 劉仁軌薨; 'the great commander' is added, and the name is spelled Liu Rengui in s0020.
In the first spring month of her second regnal year the empress dowager issued an edict the return of power to the emperor.
In the first spring month of Chuigong 2 the empress dowager issued an edict returning power to the emperor.
二年 continues the Chuigong era (s0047), not her regnal year; the sentence also lacked a verb.
In the sixth month Su Liangsi became left minister of state and Wei Daibao right minister, each of third rank at Phoenix Pavilion and Terrace.
In the sixth month Su Liangsi became left minister of state and Wei Daijia right minister, each of third rank at Phoenix Pavilion and Terrace.
韋待價 is read Wei Daijia (價 jià), as in s0091.

In the sixth month Su Liangsi became Left Minister of the Department of State Affairs; Wei Daibao, Minister of Heaven, became Right Minister—both equal in rank to the Three Offices at Phoenix Pavilion and Phoenix Terrace.

In the sixth month Su Liangsi became Left Minister of the Department of State Affairs; Wei Daijia, Minister of Heaven, became Right Minister—both equal in rank to the Three Offices at Phoenix Pavilion and Phoenix Terrace.
韋待價 is read Wei Daijia (價 jià), as in s0091.
In the fourth summer month Pei Judao became remonstrator and Zhang Guangfu, vice minister of summer affairs, joined the Phoenix Terrace as vice minister and chancellor.
In the fourth summer month Pei Judao became remonstrator and Zhang Guangfu, vice minister of summer affairs, became vice director of the Phoenix Pavilion and chancellor.
鳳閣侍郎 is vice director of the Phoenix Pavilion (not the Terrace); 同鳳閣鸞台平章事 is the chancellor designation.

Princes Yuancheng of Han and Lingqian of Lu, their sons Chan and Ai, Prince Yuan'gui of Huo and his son Xu, and Rong of Dongguan, son of the late Prince Yuanfeng of Guo, were judged complicit with Zhen; Yuancheng and Lingqian took their own lives, Yuan'gui was exiled to Qianzhou, and the rest were executed—the clan renamed Hui.

Princes Yuanjia of Han and Lingkui of Lu, their sons Zhuan and Ai, Prince Yuan'gui of Huo and his son Xu, and Rong of Dongguan, son of the late Prince Yuanfeng of Guo, were judged complicit with Zhen; Yuanjia and Lingkui took their own lives, Yuan'gui was exiled to Qianzhou, and the rest were executed—the clan renamed Hui.
元嘉 is Yuanjia and 靈夔 is Lingkui (as in s0018); 譔 is read Zhuan.

Prince Yuancheng of Han, Prince Lingqian of Lu, Yuancheng's son Chan the Duke of Huang, Lingqian's son Ai the Prince of Fanyang and left attendant of the cavalry, Prince Yuan'gui of Huo and his son Xu the Prince of Jiangdu, and Rong the Duke of Dongguan, son of the late Prince Yuanfeng of Guo, were implicated in plotting with Zhen; Yuancheng and Lingqian killed themselves, Yuan'gui was banished to Qianzhou, and Chan and the rest were executed—their surname changed to Hui.

Prince Yuanjia of Han, Prince Lingkui of Lu, Yuanjia's son Zhuan the Duke of Huang, Lingkui's son Ai the Prince of Fanyang and left attendant of the cavalry, Prince Yuan'gui of Huo and his son Xu the Prince of Jiangdu, and Rong the Duke of Dongguan, son of the late Prince Yuanfeng of Guo, were implicated in plotting with Zhen; Yuanjia and Lingkui killed themselves, Yuan'gui was banished to Qianzhou, and Zhuan and the rest were executed—their surname changed to Hui.
元嘉 is Yuanjia and 靈夔 is Lingkui (as in s0018); 譔 is read Zhuan.
Wei Daibao was punished for slow marching; his troops starved in great numbers, and he was exiled to Xiuzhou.
Wei Daijia was punished for slow marching; his troops starved in great numbers, and he was exiled to Xiuzhou.
韋待價 is read Wei Daijia (價 jià).
Wei Daibao was punished for delay in advancing; many soldiers died of hunger, and he was banished to Xiuzhou.
Wei Daijia was punished for delay in advancing; many soldiers died of hunger, and he was banished to Xiuzhou.
韋待價 is read Wei Daijia (價 jià).
In the eighth month Wang Benli, censor-in-chief of the Right Office for Censorial Reform, joined the third rank at Phoenix Pavilion and Terrace.
In the eighth month Wang Benli, censor-in-chief of the Left Office for Censorial Reform, joined the third rank at Phoenix Pavilion and Terrace.
The source has 左肅政 'Left', not 'Right'.
In the eighth month Wang Benli, Censor-in-Chief of the Right Office for Censorial Reform, was made equal in rank to the Three Offices at Phoenix Pavilion and Phoenix Terrace.
In the eighth month Wang Benli, Censor-in-Chief of the Left Office for Censorial Reform, was made equal in rank to the Three Offices at Phoenix Pavilion and Phoenix Terrace.
The source has 左肅政 'Left', not 'Right'.
In the tenth winter month Fan Lubing and Xing Wenwei were both made chancellors of the Phoenix Terrace.
In the tenth winter month Fan Lübing and Xing Wenwei were both made chancellors of the Phoenix Terrace.
范履冰: 履 is lǚ, written Lü.
In the tenth month of winter Fan Lubing, Minister of Spring; and Xing Wenwei, vice minister at Phoenix Pavilion, were both made equal in rank to the Phoenix Terrace chancellor.
In the tenth month of winter Fan Lübing, Minister of Spring; and Xing Wenwei, vice minister at Phoenix Pavilion, were both made equal in rank to the Phoenix Terrace chancellor.
范履冰: 履 is lǚ, written Lü.
On dinghai Princes Shangjin of Ze and Sunjie of Xu, with dozens of their sons, were put to death.
On dinghai Princes Shangjin of Ze and Sujie of Xu, with dozens of their sons, were put to death.
素節 is read Sujie (素 sù).
On dinghai Prince Shangjin of Ze, prefect of Suizhou, and Prince Sunjie of Xu, prefect of Shuzhou, together with several tens of their sons, were executed.
On dinghai Prince Shangjin of Ze, prefect of Suizhou, and Prince Sujie of Xu, prefect of Shuzhou, together with several tens of their sons, were executed.
素節 is read Sujie (素 sù).
She posthumously ennobled her father Shi Yue—late grand marshal and Prince of Taiyuan—as Emperor Xiaoming.
She posthumously ennobled her father Shiyue—late grand marshal and Prince of Taiyuan—as Emperor Xiaoming.
士彠 is one given name, Shiyue.
Posthumously honored the Divine Sovereign's father, the late Grand Marshal and Prince of Taiyuan Shi Yue, as Emperor Xiaoming.
Posthumously honored the Divine Sovereign's father, the late Grand Marshal and Prince of Taiyuan Shiyue, as Emperor Xiaoming.
士彠 is one given name, Shiyue.
Her nephew Chengsi became Prince of Wei; Sizan, minister of celestial offices, Prince of Liang; and twelve kinsmen including Yizong were enfeoffed as commandery princes.
Her nephew Chengsi became Prince of Wei; Sansi, minister of celestial offices, Prince of Liang; and twelve kinsmen including Yizong were enfeoffed as commandery princes.
Nephew Chengsi, left chancellor of the Secretariat, was made Prince of Wei; Sizan, minister of celestial offices, Prince of Liang; twelve clansmen including Yizong were made commandery princes.
Nephew Chengsi, Left Minister of Wenchang, was made Prince of Wei; Sansi, minister of celestial offices, Prince of Liang; twelve clansmen including Yizong were made commandery princes.
三思 is read Sansi; 文昌左相 is the Left Minister of Wenchang (Department of State Affairs), not of the Secretariat.
In the tenth winter month Wenshui in Bingzhou became Wuxing County; like Han Feng and Pei, its people's descendants received hereditary tax relief.
In the tenth winter month Wenshui in Bingzhou became Wuxing County; following the Han precedent of Feng and Pei, its people's descendants received hereditary tax relief.
依漢豐、沛例 means 'following the Han precedent of Feng and Pei'; 'Han Feng' is not a name.
In the first month of her second year she personally sacrificed at the Bright Hall.
In the first month of Tianshou 2 she personally sacrificed at the Bright Hall.
二年 continues the Tianshou era (s0110), not her personal regnal count.
In the seventh autumn month a hundred thousand households from seven Guanzhong circuits including Yong and Tong were relocated to swell Luoyang.
In the seventh autumn month several hundred thousand households from seven Guanzhong prefectures including Yong and Tong were relocated to swell Luoyang.
戶數十萬 is 'several hundred thousand households'; 州 are prefectures, not circuits.
In the seventh autumn month, a hundred thousand households from seven Guanzhong prefectures including Yong and Tong were moved to populate Luoyang.
In the seventh autumn month, several hundred thousand households from seven Guanzhong prefectures including Yong and Tong were moved to populate Luoyang.
戶數十萬 is 'several hundred thousand households'.

You Ning, right general of the Feathered Forest and Prince of Jianchang, became chief counselor; Di Renjie, Luozhou vice prefect, became terrestrial vice minister and Fengge-Luantai associate councilor.

Youning, right general of the Feathered Forest and Prince of Jianchang, became chief counselor; Di Renjie, Luozhou vice prefect, became terrestrial vice minister and Fengge-Luantai associate councilor.
攸寧 is one given name, Youning (as 武攸甯 in s0104).

You Ning, right general of the Feathered Forest Guards and Prince of Jianchang, became chief counselor; Di Renjie, Luozhou vice prefect, became vice minister of terrestrial offices and Fengge-Luantai associate councilor.

Youning, right general of the Feathered Forest Guards and Prince of Jianchang, became chief counselor; Di Renjie, Luozhou vice prefect, became vice minister of terrestrial offices and Fengge-Luantai associate councilor.
